notes: Floors 1-3 repeat one layout (unit 1 bottom-right/rear, 2 bottom-left/street, 3 top-left/street, 4 top-right/rear on the sheet), so A1-A4 sit exactly where B1-B4 are; interiors match within a few cm (A 22.4-27.9 m2 vs B 23.4-27.3 m2 footprints).

MISMATCH: the rear outdoor areas differ. Floor 1 has two large rear terraces (A4 6.24 m2, A1 6.84 m2) plus small balconies (A4 1.27, A1 1.22); the picture shows floor 2's four small rear balconies (B4 1.15 + 1.25, B1 1.32 + 1.28). The polygons cover the balconies the picture shows.
The street balconies match (A3 5.20 / A2 3.69 vs B3 5.53 / B2 3.87).

Approximate only: the picture is floor 2, the ground floor is a different plan. I3 is top-left (street), I4 top-right (rear), I2 bottom-left (street), I1 bottom-right (rear), the same quadrants as B3/B4/B2/B1, so the interior-only polygons put each code on the right quarter.

MISMATCH: the ground floor has no street balconies (entrance stair from the street at -1.50, a light well, a larger lobby), only a 0.82 m2 rear balcony for I4; its partitions differ (I3 kitchen along the party wall, I4 wraps into the rear wing, I1 has the living room in the rear wing). Use the real ground render (img/floor-ground.jpg, the default) whenever possible.

_meta.contract: coordinates are floor-image pixels (3840x2160, the img/floor-<id>.jpg grid; the -zoom.jpg images are exactly 2x: multiply by 2)
method: Unit boundaries come from the architect footprints in blender/build/model-input.json (inner wall faces, building frame in metres), the same geometry as anchors.json/units.json and the app plan sheets assets/web/floors/plan-*.png.

Each render is registered to that geometry by a homography of the wall-top (cut) plane: a 4-corner start, then ECC refinement of the projected wall mask against a 'whiteness' map of the render's wall tops (two scales, three blurs; the front face of the model masked out). Typical fit: interior walls, stair core, lift shaft and wet rooms land within about 5-15 px of the render.

A unit polygon = its footprint on the wall-top plane (exactly the visible inside of the cut-away), plus its outdoor area: on the garden floor the two gardens from the plan polygons (their walls are full height); on floors ground/1/2/3 the balconies and terraces traced from the render pixels (non-background pixels inside hand-set zones beside the facade, split at the balcony dividers), bridged to the interior across the facade wall, never overlapping another unit.
Hotspots were placed by eye on a visible floor point in each unit's living area (sofa/dining/TV zone) and are checked to sit at least 25 px inside the unit's own polygon and in no other polygon.

Orientation: in every render the street (Kountouriotou) is on the LEFT and the rear (gardens, marina side) on the RIGHT, the plan sheets' top edge (front-left party wall, frame x=0) is at the back. Verified by the stair core, the lift, the curved stair, the street balconies (left) and the gardens/terraces (right).
_meta.selfCheck: two independent label checks per unit, both passed for all 19 units: (1) the architect label point of the lab geometry (anchors.json) projected into the render falls inside that unit's polygon and no other; (2) the FLAT label printed on the app plan sheet (plan-*.png), mapped sheet -> frame -> render, falls inside the same polygon. Polygons do not overlap. Log: scratchpad h3d/v4/masks/checks.txt
